# Causal Circuit Dissection of Scale-Dependent Reasoning Degradation in Transformers: From Beneficial Activation Redistribution to Catastrophic Length Failure

## Description
Three concurrent empirical findings establish a striking paradox: short meaningless token sequences (~10-50 tokens) improve reasoning via first-layer MLP activation redistribution following an inverted-U curve (Shi et al., arXiv:2510.01032), yet long whitespace padding (3.75K-30K tokens) degrades reasoning 13.9-85% even with perfect retrieval (Du et al., EMNLP Findings 2025, arXiv:2510.05381), with hidden representation shifts detectable even at small scales (Himelstein et al., NeurIPS 2025 Workshop, arXiv:2510.01238). Existing theoretical accounts — Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical scaling (arXiv:2510.05554) and ASEntmax's unbounded softmax entropy growth (ICLR 2026) — predict *monotonic* degradation as sequence length increases, yet the observed phenomenon is *non-monotonic* (first beneficial, then harmful). This tension between theoretical prediction and empirical observation is the core intellectual puzzle driving this work: the monotonic entropy framework cannot explain why a mechanism that helps at micro-scale destroys reasoning at macro-scale.

We perform the first causal, component-level dissection of this scale-dependent phase transition. Beyond testing failure localizability (H1-Localized vs. H2-Distributed vs. H3-Architecture-dependent, following the Fragile Reasoning paper's discovery that Llama-3 failures are localizable while Qwen2.5 failures are distributed, arXiv:2604.01639), we introduce an orthogonal hypothesis dimension: **H_unified** (micro-beneficial and macro-harmful effects are mediated by the same components operating in different regimes — the same mechanism overloads) vs. **H_separate** (they are mediated by distinct component sets — different mechanisms compete). Shi et al.'s beneficial effect localizes to first-layer MLP activation redistribution; DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175) achieves up to 25% improvement on 128K-context reasoning by upweighting retrieval heads — suggesting the benefit (MLP-mediated) and the failure mitigation (attention head-mediated) may involve different circuitry. But no work has explicitly tested this overlap.

Using a tiered padding protocol (micro-scale: 0/25/50/100/200/500/750 tokens; core: 1K/5K/10K/25K tokens; extended: 50K tokens) across Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (128K native), Gemma-3-12B-it (128K native), and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (32K native, capped within native window) on GSM8K, GSM-Infinite (ICML 2025, arXiv:2502.05252, for controllable difficulty avoiding GSM8K ceiling effects), MATH, and MMLU (knowledge-intensive generalization check), we apply a two-stage causal tracing strategy: Attribution Patching (AtP-IG / RelP) as efficient first-pass screen followed by targeted full activation patching on top-50 candidates for high-fidelity causal responsibility heatmaps. A validation pilot on 2 models × 3 length conditions first verifies AtP-IG and RelP reliability at long contexts via Spearman ρ against full patching. Path patching traces specific information-flow edges that break, and the Cascading Amplification Index (CAI, from Fragile Reasoning) diagnoses failure propagation patterns. Cross-referencing maps disrupted components against SurfaceLogicKV's logic-construction heads (arXiv:2508.15806), Wu et al.'s retrieval heads (arXiv:2404.15574), DySCO's intervention targets (arXiv:2602.22175), and per-head attention entropy relative to Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical scaling. Gemma Scope 2 SAEs/transcoders provide feature-level decomposition on Gemma-3-12B. A position-controlled ablation (post-question padding preserving question tokens at position [0, L]) isolates positional encoding confounds from attention redistribution effects.

The key deliverable is not merely a catalog of disrupted components, but a mechanistic answer to whether the beneficial-to-harmful transition reflects a single circuit overloading or competing circuits — directly informing whether length-robust interventions should target a unified mechanism (as DySCO's heuristic approach implicitly assumes) or must address fundamentally distinct failure modes. Each hypothesis outcome is publishable and yields distinct engineering implications: principled component selection strategies for inference-time interventions (replacing DySCO's heuristic retrieval-head selection), targeted regularization objectives for long-context fine-tuning, or model-selection guidance based on architectural failure signatures.

## Core Problem
Why does padding-induced input length have a non-monotonic effect on transformer reasoning — improving performance at micro-scale (~10-50 tokens) via MLP activation redistribution, yet degrading it 13.9-85% at macro-scale (~10K-30K tokens) even with perfect retrieval — and are the micro-beneficial and macro-harmful effects mediated by the same transformer components operating in different regimes, or by distinct component sets?

## Opportunity
Three concurrent empirical findings create a paradox with no mechanistic resolution. Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032) showed short meaningless tokens (~10-50) *improve* reasoning via first-layer MLP activation redistribution (ARM effect), following an inverted-U curve collapsing beyond ~50-70 tokens. Du et al. (EMNLP Findings 2025, arXiv:2510.05381) demonstrated long whitespace padding (3.75K-30K tokens) degrades reasoning 13.9-85% across 5 LLMs even with perfect retrieval and masked distractors, explicitly calling for "further exploration of underlying mechanisms." Himelstein et al. (NeurIPS 2025 Workshop, arXiv:2510.01238) showed even small padding shifts hidden representations, degrades quality, and weakens safety guardrails.

Crucially, existing theoretical frameworks predict only *monotonic* degradation: Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical scaling (arXiv:2510.05554) and ASEntmax's unbounded softmax entropy proof (ICLR 2026) both imply attention quality degrades monotonically with sequence length. The *non-monotonic* observation — benefit then harm — cannot be explained by entropy growth alone, since entropy theory has no mechanism for the initial improvement. This means a purely attention-centric account is insufficient; the MLP-mediated benefit at micro-scale (Shi et al.) and the attention-mediated failure at macro-scale must involve additional mechanisms beyond entropy dilution. Identifying these mechanisms requires causal, component-level tracing — not just behavioral measurement.

Activation patching and causal tracing tools are now mature: Anthropic's 2025 circuit tracing at production scale (Attribution Graphs); Syed et al.'s AtP requiring only 2 forward + 1 backward pass (NeurIPS 2023 Workshop, arXiv:2310.10348); RelP with LRP propagation for improved signal-to-noise (NeurIPS 2025 MechInterp Workshop Spotlight, arXiv:2508.21258); and Stream (arXiv:2510.19875) enabling mechanistic interpretability at 100K-token contexts. Meanwhile, DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175, Feb 2026) demonstrates that heuristic retrieval-head upweighting yields up to 25% improvement on 128K-context reasoning benchmarks — proving head-level intervention works, but without explaining *why* those specific heads matter or whether non-retrieval components also contribute to failure. "How does Chain of Thought Think?" (arXiv:2507.22928) shows SAE + activation patching can causally verify feature-level contributions to reasoning, establishing methodological precedent for our SAE-based analysis.

The Fragile Reasoning paper (arXiv:2604.01639) revealed a critical architectural divide: Llama-3 failures under surface perturbations are localizable (43/60 recoverable via layer patching, 71.7%) while Qwen2.5 failures are fully distributed (0/60 recoverable). This raises two open questions: (1) does length-induced degradation follow the same model-dependent localizability pattern? (2) do the components mediating micro-scale benefit overlap with those mediating macro-scale failure?

## Landscape
**Empirical phenomenon (well-established):** Du et al. (EMNLP Findings 2025) showed 13.9-85% degradation across Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-v0.3-7B, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5, and Gemini-2.0 using whitespace padding at 0/3.75K/7.5K/15K/30K tokens on GSM8K, MMLU, and HumanEval. The Intelligence Degradation paper (arXiv:2601.15300) identified critical thresholds at 40-50% of max context where performance collapses >30%. Rodionov et al. (arXiv:2604.01161, April 2026) showed longer context compresses reasoning traces by up to 50% with reduced self-verification — behavioral observation without component-level tracing. The Chroma Context Rot Report (2025) confirmed context rot as an intrinsic property of attention architectures across 18 models.

**Paradoxical micro-scale benefit:** Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032) demonstrated short meaningless tokens (~10-50 repeated punctuation) *improve* reasoning by redistributing MLP activations — near-zero activations become less frequent while large-magnitude activations increase. This occurs primarily in the first attention layer, following an inverted-U curve peaking around 50 tokens. Their ARM module reproduces the benefit without token insertion. Himelstein et al. (arXiv:2510.01238, NeurIPS 2025 Workshop) showed even small padding shifts hidden representations across Llama, Gemma, and Qwen families.

**Theoretical accounts (monotonic only):** Chen et al. (arXiv:2510.05554) proved attention exhibits a phase transition governed by β_n: insufficient scaling collapses tokens, excessive scaling reduces attention to identity, with critical scaling at β_n = log(n). ASEntmax (ICLR 2026) proved unbounded softmax entropy growth with sequence length. The Intrinsic Entropy paper (arXiv:2502.01481) links training data to optimal context length. **Key limitation:** all three frameworks predict purely monotonic degradation — none can account for the initial micro-scale benefit, meaning a pure attention-entropy explanation is insufficient for the full phenomenon.

**Inference-time intervention (heuristic):** DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175, Feb 2026) leverages Wu et al.'s retrieval heads to dynamically upweight task-relevant tokens at each decoding step, achieving up to 25% relative improvement on MRCR and LongBenchV2 at 128K context. DySCO's three-stage algorithm (aggregation → selection → rescaling) operates on retrieval heads identified via heuristic criteria. **This proves head-level intervention works**, but DySCO does not explain *why* retrieval heads matter mechanistically, whether all causally relevant heads are captured by the retrieval-head taxonomy, or whether non-attention components (e.g., MLPs) also contribute to length-induced failure. Our causal tracing directly addresses these questions, potentially providing principled component selection that could improve upon DySCO's heuristic approach.

**Mechanistic interpretability on related problems:** Wu et al. (arXiv:2404.15574) identified retrieval heads — sparse <5% of attention heads, universal, intrinsic, and critical for CoT reasoning; masking causes cascading failure. SurfaceLogicKV (arXiv:2508.15806) classified 98.5% heads as irrelevant-info-ignoring, 1.5% as logic-construction, 0.5% as surface memorization. "Transformers Know but Don't Tell" (EMNLP Findings 2024, arXiv:2406.14673) showed models internally represent answers they fail to output. The Fragile Reasoning paper (arXiv:2604.01639) applied activation patching to surface perturbations: Llama-3 failures localized (71.7% recoverable), Mistral (5%), Qwen (0%). CircuitProbe (Panuganti, arXiv:2604.00716) identified stability-zone and magnitude-zone reasoning circuits via layer duplication without studying length. Fartale et al. (arXiv:2510.03366) disentangled recall vs. reasoning circuits without varying context length. "How does Chain of Thought Think?" (arXiv:2507.22928) used SAE + activation patching to study CoT faithfulness at the feature level, finding CoT induces sparser and more causally effective internal features in larger models — establishing methodological precedent for SAE-based causal reasoning analysis.

**Critical gap:** No existing work uses causal interventions to trace where pure length disrupts the reasoning computation graph. More specifically: (1) no work explains the mechanistic transition from micro-scale benefit (Shi et al.) to macro-scale harm (Du et al.); (2) no work tests whether length-induced failures follow the same model-dependent localizability as surface perturbation failures (Fragile Reasoning); (3) no work tests whether micro-beneficial and macro-harmful effects involve the same or different component sets; (4) DySCO demonstrates head-level intervention works but provides no mechanistic grounding for *why* those heads matter.

## Approach
**Phase 1 — Reproduction, scale-transition characterization, and control experiments (Weeks 1-3).** Reproduce Du et al.'s whitespace-padding protocol across Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (128K native), Gemma-3-12B-it (128K native, Gemma Scope 2 support), and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (32K native, capped within native window). **Benchmarks:** GSM8K and GSM-Infinite (ICML 2025, arXiv:2502.05252) for math reasoning (GSM-Infinite provides controllable difficulty, avoiding GSM8K's ceiling effect for frontier 7-8B models); MATH for harder reasoning; MMLU for knowledge-intensive generalization check. **Tiered padding protocol** with transition-zone coverage: micro-scale at 0/25/50/100/200/500/750 tokens; core at 1K/5K/10K/25K tokens (all within native windows); extended at 50K tokens (Llama, Gemma only). All cross-model comparisons normalized by token count (not character count), with tokenizer encoding differences explicitly reported. For each model-condition pair, create paired datasets of (short-context-correct, long-context-incorrect) examples (~500 per condition; 100-200 for 50K to manage compute). At micro-scale, measure MLP activation distributions (replicating Shi et al.'s ARM finding) and per-head attention entropy. **Position-controlled ablation:** for core conditions, run a parallel set with padding placed *after* the question (preserving question tokens at position [0, L]) to isolate positional encoding confounds from attention redistribution effects; compare causal tracing heatmaps between pre-padding and post-padding conditions.

**Phase 2 — Validation pilot and efficient causal screening (Weeks 3-6).** **Validation pilot (Week 3):** On 2 models × 3 length conditions (1K, 10K, 25K) × 50-100 examples, simultaneously run AtP-IG (Syed et al., arXiv:2310.10348), RelP (arXiv:2508.21258), and full activation patching on all ~1024 components. Compute Spearman ρ between AtP-IG/RelP rankings and full-patching ground truth to verify approximate methods remain reliable at long contexts despite LayerNorm nonlinearities. If ρ < 0.7 at any length, switch to full patching with gradient checkpointing + bfloat16 for that condition. **Main screening (Weeks 4-6):** Apply the validated method across all model-condition pairs to rank all components by causal responsibility. Use Stream (arXiv:2510.19875) for memory-efficient attention pattern visualization at long contexts (not for activation patching).

**Phase 3 — Targeted full activation patching and path patching (Weeks 6-9).** Apply full activation patching to top-50 components per model-condition pair: swap short-context activation into long-context pass, measure accuracy recovery. Apply path patching to top-20 components to trace specific information-flow edges that break. Compute CAI (Cascading Amplification Index, from Fragile Reasoning, arXiv:2604.01639) to diagnose whether divergence amplifies or self-corrects across layers. **H_unified vs H_separate test:** Explicitly compare the set of components causally implicated at micro-scale (beneficial regime, e.g., 25-50 tokens) with the set implicated at macro-scale (harmful regime, e.g., 10K-25K tokens). Compute Jaccard overlap of top-50 component sets across scale conditions. High overlap (>0.5) supports H_unified (same mechanism overloads); low overlap (<0.2) supports H_separate (different mechanisms compete).

**Phase 4 — Cross-referencing, DySCO comparison, and mechanistic synthesis (Weeks 9-11).** Cross-reference disrupted components with: (a) SurfaceLogicKV's head classification (arXiv:2508.15806) — are logic-construction heads disproportionately disrupted? (b) Wu et al.'s retrieval heads (arXiv:2404.15574) — are the sparse <5% retrieval heads selectively disrupted by length? (c) **DySCO's intervention targets (arXiv:2602.22175)** — compute overlap between our causally-implicated heads and DySCO's retrieval-head selection; test whether our causal heatmap identifies additional non-retrieval components that DySCO misses, and whether DySCO's blanket upweighting is optimal vs. the differentiated weighting our causal scores suggest. (d) Per-head attention entropy as a function of padding length, testing whether causally implicated heads are those crossing Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical threshold. For Gemma-3-12B, use Gemma Scope 2 SAEs and transcoders (Google DeepMind, 2026) for feature-level decomposition, tracking which features activate/deactivate across the length transition. All H3 cross-model comparisons use normalized metrics (causally implicated components as % of total components) to control for Gemma-3-12B's larger parameter count.

**Phase 5 — Probing, hypothesis testing, and statistical validation (Weeks 11-13).** **Probing protocol:** Train linear probes on residual-stream representations at every layer (layer 0 to final), using short-context correct examples' representations as training data, probing for final-answer correctness. Measure layer-by-layer probe accuracy under long-context conditions to distinguish information preservation (probe accuracy remains high in early/middle layers) from propagation failure (sharp drop at specific layers) vs. global corruption (uniform accuracy decline). This extends the "Transformers Know but Don't Tell" (arXiv:2406.14673) finding from retrieval to reasoning under length pressure. Test H1/H2/H3 localizability hypotheses and H_unified/H_separate overlap hypothesis. **Statistical rigor:** All accuracy and recovery rates reported with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. H3 cross-model comparisons validated via permutation tests. AtP attribution rankings assessed via split-half stability analysis (Spearman ρ across random 50/50 splits of examples).

**Phase 6 — Scale-transition mechanistic narrative (Weeks 13-15).** Synthesize into a unified mechanistic account: trace how first-layer MLP activation redistribution (Shi et al.'s ARM effect) interacts with attention entropy growth, retrieval head disruption, and logic-construction head failure across the scale transition. Distinguish between the H_unified account (single circuit with a capacity threshold) and H_separate account (competing circuits where MLP benefit is eventually overwhelmed by attention-mediated harm). Deliverable: component-level circuit diagram of the beneficial-to-harmful transition, parameterized by padding length, with explicit connection to DySCO's intervention strategy and implications for principled alternatives.

【缺陷 1】
- 类别: 实验设计不足（架构差异未处理）
- 问题: Proposal 将 Gemma-3-12B-it 与 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 并列进行统一的 causal tracing 方案，但 **Gemma 3 使用 interleaved local-global attention（每 5 个 local 层 span 仅 1024 tokens，搭配 1 个 global 层）**，而 Llama 和 Qwen 使用完整的 full attention。这意味着在 Gemma 3 上，padding tokens 超过 1024 距离后，5/6 的层根本无法 attend 到这些 tokens。这从根本上改变了 causal tracing 的解读：Gemma 3 上可能观察到的 "localized failure" 实际上可能是架构层面的 attention mask 限制，而非 reasoning circuit 的固有属性。Proposal 完全没有讨论这一架构差异对实验方法和结论的影响。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: 
  (1) 在实验设计中明确区分 Gemma 3 的 local vs. global 层，分别报告 causal responsibility heatmap——local 层的 causal effect 在长 padding 条件下预期应该很弱（因为看不到 padding tokens），而 global 层应承载主要效应。这本身就是一个有意义的发现。
  (2) 在 H1/H2/H3 localizability 分析中，增加一个 sub-hypothesis：H3-Architecture 不仅意味着不同模型有不同 localizability，还意味着同一模型内 local vs. global 层有不同 failure mode。
  (3) 如果追求三模型可比性更重要，考虑替换 Gemma-3-12B 为另一个 full-attention 模型（如 Mistral-v0.3-7B，Du et al. 的原始测试模型之一），然后将 Gemma 3 作为附加的 architectural contrast 实验。
  (4) 至少在 paper 中明确讨论 sliding window 架构如何影响 padding tokens 的信息传播路径。
- 调研依据: Gemma 3 Technical Report (arXiv:2503.19786) 明确记载 interleaved local-global attention 架构；GitHub issue (google-deepmind/gemma#167) 确认 local 层 span 仅 1024 tokens。

【缺陷 2】
- 类别: 实验设计不足（padding 类型控制条件缺失）
- 问题: Proposal 继承了 Du et al. 的 whitespace padding 协议，但 **缺少 padding 类型的控制实验**。对于一个声称要做 "causal circuit dissection" 的工作，仅使用 whitespace padding 无法区分以下两种机制：(a) 纯粹的 positional shift / attention dilution 效应（任何类型的 padding 都会产生同样的 circuit disruption），(b) content-dependent 效应（whitespace 的 token embedding 本身影响 MLP/attention 行为）。这一区分对 H_unified vs. H_separate 的测试至关重要——如果不同 padding 类型产生不同的 disrupted circuit sets，这直接影响 overlap 分析的结论。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 增加至少一种替代 padding 条件：**random token padding**（从 vocabulary 中均匀采样 tokens）。在 2-3 个关键长度条件（如 1K、10K、25K）上运行，并与 whitespace padding 的 causal tracing heatmap 做对比。如果两者 disrupted component sets 高度重叠（Jaccard > 0.7），则确认效应是 position/attention-driven；如果差异显著，则需要在 mechanistic narrative 中区分 content-dependent pathway。
  (2) 这不需要对所有条件做完整的 tiered protocol，只需在 core conditions 上做抽检，计算量可控（约增加 20-30% GPU hours 在 Phase 3）。
  (3) Proposal 已有 position-controlled ablation（post-question padding），这是好的。但 padding type variation 是正交的另一个控制维度。
- 调研依据: Du et al. (arXiv:2510.05381) 使用了 whitespace 和 masked distractor 两种条件，发现效应模式不同，表明 padding 内容确实影响 degradation pattern。Proposal 的 causal tracing 应继承这一控制维度。

【缺陷 3】
- 类别: 可行性问题（micro-scale flipped sample 数量不足风险）
- 问题: Proposal 要求每个 model-condition pair 创建约 500 个 (short-context-correct, long-context-incorrect) paired examples。但在 **micro-scale 条件**（25/50/100 tokens padding）下，这些 7-8B 模型在 GSM8K 上的 accuracy 下降预计非常小（Shi et al. 显示这些长度甚至是 beneficial 的）。这意味着 flip rate 可能极低——正确答案变为错误答案的比例可能 <5%。从 GSM8K 的约 1300 条测试集中，可能只能找到 <65 个 flipped examples，远不足 500 个。在 "beneficial regime" 中做 causal tracing 的 sample 从何而来？
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 重新定义 micro-scale 的 causal tracing 目标：在 beneficial regime 中，tracing 的目标不应该是 flipped (correct→incorrect) samples，而是 **boosted (incorrect→correct) samples**——即在 zero-padding 时错误、但加入 25-50 tokens padding 后变为正确的例子。这些 sample 直接对应 Shi et al. 的 ARM 效应。
  (2) 同时收集 boosted samples 和 flipped samples。在 micro-scale 用 boosted samples 做 "beneficial circuit" 的 causal tracing，在 macro-scale 用 flipped samples 做 "harmful circuit" 的 causal tracing。然后比较两组 circuit 的 overlap → 直接测试 H_unified vs H_separate。
  (3) 使用 GSM-Infinite 的可调难度功能，生成难度适中的问题，确保 baseline accuracy 在 40-60% 范围，从而在 micro-scale 也能获得足够的 boosted samples。
  (4) 明确报告每个条件下实际获得的 paired sample 数量和 bootstrap power analysis。
- 调研依据: Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032) 报告短 padding 在 GSM8K 上提升 accuracy，意味着 micro-scale 的 "flip" 主要是 incorrect→correct 方向。Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639) 在 677 题中获得 28-45% flip rate 作为参考。

- 类别: 评估方案缺陷（Jaccard overlap 阈值的中间地带）

- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 引入 **连续化指标** 替代或补充二元阈值：使用 weighted Jaccard（按 causal effect magnitude 加权），或计算两组 component 的 causal effect vector 的 cosine similarity。这些连续指标避免了 arbitrary threshold 的问题。
  (2) 做 **cutoff sensitivity analysis**：报告 top-20、top-50、top-100 components 的 Jaccard overlap，展示结论对 cutoff 选择的鲁棒性。
  (3) 明确定义中间区间的解读：0.2-0.5 可定义为 "partial overlap"，对应 "partially shared mechanism" 假说——某些 components 在两个 regime 中都活跃，但各 regime 还有自己特有的 components。这本身就是一个有意义的结论，应在实验设计中预先承认。
  (4) 补充 permutation test：随机 shuffle component labels，计算 null distribution 的 Jaccard overlap，确保观测到的 overlap 具有统计显著性。
- 调研依据: 基于领域实验规范判断——mechanistic interpretability 文献中 arbitrary thresholds 是常见审稿质疑点；Fragile Reasoning 的 localizability 测试也使用了连续化的 recovery rate 而非二元分类。

【缺陷 5】
- 类别: compute 公平性问题（Gemma-3-12B 与 7-8B 模型的参数量差异）
- 问题: Proposal 提到 "All H3 cross-model comparisons use normalized metrics (causally implicated components as % of total components) to control for Gemma-3-12B's larger parameter count"，这是好的。但 **Gemma-3-12B 有 ~48 layers（12B），而 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 有 ~32 layers**。百分比归一化无法完全控制的问题是：更深的模型本身可能有更多冗余层，使得 "关键 component 占比" 天然更低。此外，Gemma 3 的 interleaved local-global 架构使得每层的 "component" 定义本身就不可比——local 层的 attention head 功能受限于 1024 span，与 full-attention 层的 head 本质不同。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 在 normalized metrics 基础上，增加 **absolute metrics**（absolute number of causally implicated components 和 recovery rate）并行报告。
  (2) 对 Gemma-3-12B 单独报告 local-layer 和 global-layer 的归一化指标，不将两种层混在一起算百分比。
  (3) 考虑在 Llama 和 Qwen 之间做主要的 cross-model comparison（两者架构更可比），将 Gemma 3 作为 "architectural contrast" 而非等权对比。
  (4) 在写作中明确讨论参数量和架构差异对 cross-model comparison 的限制。
- 调研依据: Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639) 的跨模型比较仅用同规模模型（均为 7-8B），避免了此问题。DySCO 也在 7-8B tier 内做主要比较。

【缺陷 6】
- 类别: 可行性问题（full activation patching 在 25K-50K tokens 的计算量可能被低估）
- 问题: Proposal 估计 targeted activation patching on top-50 components 需要 ~220 H100 hours。但让我们粗略计算：3 models × ~12 conditions × ~500 examples × 50 components × 2 forward passes (clean + patched) = 1,800,000 forward passes。在 25K tokens 时，一个 8B 模型的单次 forward pass 约 3-5 秒（H100, bfloat16），则总计约 1,500-2,500 GPU hours——**远超 220 小时的估计**。即使只在 core conditions（1K/5K/10K/25K）上做 full patching（4 conditions），也约 360K forward passes = ~300-500 hours。估计值可能低估了 5-10 倍。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) **大幅缩减 full patching 的覆盖范围**：不对所有 12 个 padding conditions 都做 top-50 full patching。建议选择 3-4 个关键 conditions（如 0, 50, 5K, 25K——覆盖 micro-beneficial、transition、macro-harmful 三个 regime）做 full patching，其余 conditions 仅用 AtP/RelP screening 结果。
  (2) **减少每个 condition 的 sample 数**：从 500 减至 200 per condition for full patching（AtP screening 可保持 500）。200 examples 配合 bootstrap 仍可产生合理的 confidence intervals。
  (3) **batch processing 优化**：利用 KV cache 共享——同一 clean input 的 KV cache 可在 50 个 component patching 实验中复用，减少重复 prefill 开销。
  (4) 重新估算 GPU budget：建议将 full patching 预算调整为 400-600 H100 hours（占总预算的主要部分），总预算调至 600-900 H100 hours（$1,500-$2,250）。
- 调研依据: 基于领域实验规范判断——Fragile Reasoning 仅对 60 个 flipped samples 做 full patching（而非 500），"How does CoT Think?" 使用小模型（<3B）做 SAE patching 以控制计算成本。大规模 full patching 在 8-12B 模型 + 25K+ tokens 上的计算开销是公开可查的工程约束。

【缺陷 7】
- 类别: 评估方案缺陷（MMLU 的异质性问题）
- 问题: Proposal 将 MMLU 作为 "knowledge-intensive generalization check"，但 MMLU 包含 57 个 subjects，从 abstract algebra 到 professional medicine，任务类型高度异质。对 MMLU 做 causal tracing 时，不同 subject 的 circuit 可能完全不同，aggregate 的 causal responsibility heatmap 会很 noisy。此外，MMLU 是 multiple-choice format（4 选 1），而 GSM8K/MATH 是 free-form numerical answers——两种 format 的 "correct→incorrect flip" 定义和 patching 目标（patching 哪个 logit？）有本质区别。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 如果 MMLU 的目的仅是 "generalization check"（验证 length-induced degradation 在知识密集型任务上也存在），则只需报告 **behavioral results**（accuracy vs. padding length curves），不需要对 MMLU 做 full causal tracing。这大幅节省计算资源。
  (2) 如果确实要对非推理任务做 causal tracing，选择 MMLU 的一个同质子集（如 STEM subjects 或 professional medicine），而非全部 57 subjects。
  (3) 明确 MMLU 的 patching 目标：multiple-choice 格式下，patching target 应该是 correct choice token 的 logit（如 "A"/"B"/"C"/"D"），与 GSM8K 的 final numerical answer logit 不同。这需要在方法论中显式说明。
- 调研依据: Du et al. (arXiv:2510.05381) 在 MMLU 上仅报告了 aggregate accuracy degradation，未做 component-level analysis。Fragile Reasoning 仅在 GSM8K 上做 causal tracing，避免了 task heterogeneity 问题。

【缺陷 8】
- 类别: ablation 不完整（probing protocol 缺乏 token position 规范）
- 问题: Phase 5 的 probing protocol 描述为 "Train linear probes on residual-stream representations at every layer"，但 **未指定 probe 在哪个 token position 的 representation 上操作**。对于有 padding 的输入（可能 25K tokens），residual stream 在不同 token positions 有不同的 representation。是 probe 最后一个 token 的 representation？question 最后一个 token？answer 区域？这个选择直接影响 "information preservation vs. propagation failure" 的诊断结果。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 明确规定 probe 操作在 **最后一个 question token 的 residual stream representation** 上（即 padding 后、generation 前的最后一个 token position）。这是最自然的选择，因为模型需要从此处开始 generation。
  (2) 作为 ablation，额外 probe padding 前的最后一个 question token position（即 position L，如 proposal 中 position-controlled ablation 所定义），比较两者的 probe accuracy 差异以量化 positional shift 的影响。
  (3) 这是一个小的写作/规范问题，不影响核心实验设计，但审稿人可能追问。
- 调研依据: "Transformers Know but Don't Tell" (arXiv:2406.14673) 在特定 token position 上做 probing，明确指定了 probe 的 position 选择策略。

---

**总结**: 该 proposal 的实验框架总体设计良好——tiered padding protocol、validation pilot、multi-method causal tracing (AtP → full patching → path patching)、跨模型比较、position-controlled ablation、statistical rigor 等方面都体现了成熟的实验设计思路。上述缺陷中，**缺陷 1（Gemma 3 sliding window 架构）和缺陷 6（compute 估算偏低）是最关键的**，前者可能导致跨模型比较的结论被审稿人质疑，后者可能导致项目执行中遇到资源瓶颈。其余缺陷均为可通过增加控制条件或细化 protocol 来补救的中等问题。没有发现不可补救的方向性致命缺陷——实验方案的核心逻辑（causal tracing across scale transition）是 sound 的。

Now I have sufficient research material. Let me compile my analysis.

【状态】: 有发掘空间

【前置调研发现】
- **Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032)**: 确认 micro-scale 的 ARM 效应定位在第一层 MLP 的激活重分布，使用的是 repeated punctuation 等 meaningless tokens（非纯 whitespace），inverted-U 曲线在 ~50-70 tokens 后 collapse。
- **Du et al. (arXiv:2510.05381, EMNLP Findings 2025)**: 使用 whitespace padding 在 3.75K-30K tokens 观察到 13.9-85% 降级，明确呼吁进一步探索底层机制。关键：使用的 padding 类型与 Shi et al. 不同。
- **Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639)**: 发现 Llama-3 失败可定位（71.7% 恢复），Qwen2.5 完全分布式（0% 恢复），引入 CAI 和 MPD 框架。方法论上是本 proposal 最近的前辈。
- **Localized Definitions and Distributed Reasoning (arXiv:2504.02976)**: 在 fine-tuned GPT-2 上用 CLAP 方法发现事实知识定位化，关联知识分布式——与本 proposal 的 localized vs. distributed 假设高度相关但在不同任务上。
- **DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175)**: Princeton 团队证明启发式 retrieval head upweighting 在 128K 上下文有效（最高 25% 提升），但完全没有解释 why those heads matter。方法是三阶段 aggregation → selection → rescaling。
- **Rodionov et al. (arXiv:2604.01161)**: 发现长上下文导致推理链压缩高达 50%，self-verification 行为减少——这是行为观察，缺乏组件级别解释。
- **Stream (arXiv:2510.19875)**: 实现 90-99% attention link pruning，在消费级 GPU 上支持长上下文 mechanistic interpretability。
- **Causal Attribution via Activation Patching (arXiv:2603.13652, March 2026)**: 在 ViT 上的 CAAP 方法表明 activation patching 在不同架构上持续发展，但没有 LLM 长上下文推理应用。
- **Logic Haystacks (arXiv:2502.17169)**: 在语义整合的（非 trivially ignorable 的）长上下文中测试逻辑推理，与本 proposal 的纯 whitespace padding 形成对比维度——proposal 未提及。

- **调研总结**: 该领域当前研究者主要从两个方向突破：(1) 用 causal tracing 工具（AtP, 路径修补, SAE）在组件级别解释推理行为，但尚未应用于长度诱导的降级；(2) 在行为层面大量记录长上下文降级现象（Du et al., Rodionov et al., Intelligence Degradation），但停留在"什么发生了"而非"为什么发生"。**没有任何工作将 Shi et al. 的 micro-scale benefit 和 Du et al. 的 macro-scale harm 在同一因果框架内连接**——这是一个真实的 gap。但该 gap 的成立依赖于一个未被验证的前提：这两种效应是否存在于同一连续曲线上。

---

【发掘点 1】
- 维度: 前提假设质疑 / trivial alternative 威胁
- 内容: **Proposal 的核心"non-monotonic paradox"建立在一个未经验证的前提上：Shi et al. 的 micro-benefit 和 Du et al. 的 macro-harm 是同一现象的两个阶段。但这两项工作使用了不同类型的 padding——Shi et al. 使用 repeated meaningless punctuation tokens（如 "!!!" ），Du et al. 使用 whitespace padding。** 如果 whitespace 在 micro-scale 不产生 ARM 效应（因为 whitespace tokens 的处理方式与 punctuation tokens 不同，不一定会触发 first-layer MLP 激活重分布），那么整个 non-monotonic 曲线根本不存在——这两个是各自独立的现象，被人为拼接在同一坐标轴上。这是审稿人最可能提出的致命质疑。**建议：Phase 1 必须明确将 padding type 作为一个实验维度——在 0-750 tokens 的 micro-scale 上同时测试 whitespace padding 和 meaningless punctuation tokens，验证 non-monotonic curve 是否在同一 token type 下成立。如果 whitespace 在 micro-scale 无 benefit，则 paradox framing 需要重新定义——不再是"长度的 non-monotonic 效应"，而是"两种不同的 token-induced 效应在长度维度上的竞争"，这实际上直接支持 H_separate 假设而非留其为 open question。**
- 价值: 这直接关乎核心 claim 的逻辑基础。如果前提不成立，novelty claim 从"解释一个 paradox"降级为"用 causal tracing 研究已知的长度降级"，后者的 novelty 显著降低。提前做这个验证并根据结果调整 framing 可以堵住最大的审稿漏洞。
- 调研依据: 基于对 Shi et al. 原文的仔细阅读——其 ARM 效应明确来自 meaningless punctuation tokens 的处理，不是任意 token 类型。Du et al. 使用的是纯 whitespace。两者的 token 类型差异在 proposal 中被完全忽略。

【发掘点 2】
- 维度: novelty 锐化
- 内容: **当前 proposal 的 H_separate 结果（最可能的 outcome）可能被审稿人认为 "I would have guessed this"。** Shi et al. 已经把 benefit 定位到 first-layer MLPs，attention entropy 理论已经预测 attention 介导的 harm——如果 causal tracing 只是确认 "micro-benefit 在 MLP，macro-harm 在 attention heads"，novelty 有限。**建议：增加一个更锐利的第三假设 H_interaction——MLP 介导的 benefit 是否 depends on attention 没有降级？** 即：在 micro-scale，attention 仍正常运作，所以 MLP 的激活重分布能被下游正确利用；在 macro-scale，attention 降级导致即使 MLP 仍在做激活重分布，下游也无法利用。这个假设预测了一个可测试的 interaction effect：在长上下文中，如果你用 DySCO 式方法修复 attention heads，MLP 的 ARM benefit 是否会 "回来"？这比单纯的 Jaccard overlap 更有机械洞见，即使 H_separate 成立（不同组件集合），也能揭示它们之间的依赖关系。
- 价值: 这将最可能的"不意外"结果（H_separate）转化为一个有深度的机械性发现——不仅是"不同电路"，而是"不同电路之间存在单向依赖：MLP benefit 需要 attention 正常运作作为前提"。这直接提升了 significance，因为它解释了为什么 DySCO 的 attention 修复同时恢复了整体推理——不仅因为修了 attention，还因为恢复了 MLP benefit 的可利用性。命中 Novelty + Significance。
- 调研依据: 基于 DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175) 的发现——纯 attention head upweighting 就能恢复 25% 推理性能。如果 macro-harm 仅是 attention 问题，修复 attention 就够了；但如果 MLP 也独立受损，DySCO 的 25% 恢复就不应如此有效。这暗示 MLP 和 attention 之间可能存在依赖关系，而非完全独立的两个故障模式。

【发掘点 3】
- 维度: significance 提升
- 内容: **Proposal 当前的 significance 叙事主要停留在"理解机制"层面。但 Rodionov et al. (arXiv:2604.01161) 的发现——长上下文导致推理链压缩 50%、self-verification 减少——可以被本 proposal 的 causal tracing 直接解释。** 如果 causal tracing 发现特定的 "self-verification circuit"（如某些 attention heads 负责回溯检查中间步骤）在长上下文下被 disrupted，这就为 Rodionov 的行为观察提供了组件级别的因果解释。**建议在 motivation 和 contribution 中明确连接：本工作不仅解释 accuracy 降级，还可能解释 WHY 模型在长上下文下跳过 self-verification——因为负责 verification 的组件被 length disrupted。** 这将 significance 从"理解一个 benchmark 数字下降"提升到"理解推理行为质变的机械原因"。
- 价值: 命中 Significance 维度。Accuracy 降级是一个数字；推理过程质变（压缩、跳过验证）是一个认知层面的失败模式。将因果解释连接到后者比前者更有影响力，且让 paper 与更广泛的 "reasoning faithfulness" 文献（包括 CoT faithfulness, arXiv:2507.22928）产生联系。
- 调研依据: Rodionov et al. (arXiv:2604.01161) 的推理压缩发现 + "How does Chain of Thought Think?" (arXiv:2507.22928) 的 SAE-based reasoning faithfulness 分析，两者都指向"长上下文不仅降低准确率，还改变推理过程本身"这一更深层的问题。

【发掘点 4】
- 维度: related work 差异化
- 内容: **Proposal 目前未提及一个关键的定位对比：与 "Localized Definitions and Distributed Reasoning" (arXiv:2504.02976) 的关系。** 该工作在 fine-tuned GPT-2 上发现 "factual knowledge is localized, associative knowledge is distributed"，这与本 proposal 的 H1-Localized vs. H2-Distributed 假设直接相关。**差异化需要明确：** (1) 该工作在 factual recall vs. reasoning 上研究 localization，本 proposal 在 length-induced failure 上研究——不同的 perturbation 维度；(2) 该工作在 GPT-2 上，本 proposal 在现代 7-12B 模型上；(3) 该工作不涉及 scale-dependent transition。此外，**Fragile Reasoning paper 已经在 surface perturbation 上做了 localized vs. distributed 的分类——本 proposal 需要明确说明为什么 length perturbation 可能产生与 surface perturbation 不同的 localizability pattern，否则审稿人会问"你为什么不直接预测 Llama 是 localized、Qwen 是 distributed，跟 Fragile Reasoning 一样？"**
- 价值: 命中 Related Work 差异化维度。清晰的定位防止审稿人认为这只是 Fragile Reasoning 在另一个 perturbation type 上的 straightforward extension。关键差异化论点应该是：length perturbation 与 surface perturbation 有质的不同——surface perturbation 改变语义信号，length perturbation 不改变语义信号但改变计算路径长度和 attention 分布，因此可能产生完全不同的 localizability pattern。
- 调研依据: Localized Definitions and Distributed Reasoning (arXiv:2504.02976) + Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639)。两者都研究了 localized vs. distributed failure pattern，但在不同维度上。本 proposal 需要与两者都建立清晰差异。

【发掘点 5】
- 维度: 核心 claim 强化
- 内容: **Proposal 对 "monotonic theoretical prediction vs. non-monotonic empirical observation" 这一张力的表述有逻辑漏洞。** Chen et al. 的 β_n = log(n) 和 ASEntmax 的 unbounded entropy 是关于 **attention** 的理论。Shi et al. 的 micro-benefit 是 **MLP-mediated** 的。两者不在同一个组件上——所以 attention entropy 的 monotonic prediction 与 MLP-mediated benefit 之间不构成真正的 "tension"。这就像说"引力理论预测物体下落，但电磁力让物体上升——这是 paradox"——不是的，这只是两个不同力的叠加。**建议将理论张力重新表述为：** "当前理论框架覆盖了 attention 维度但完全忽视了 MLP 维度的 length sensitivity。即使 attention entropy monotonically degrades，MLP 组件可能 non-monotonically respond to length，而两者的叠加产生了观察到的 non-monotonic 行为曲线。现有理论无法预测这一叠加的转折点在哪里——这正是需要 causal tracing 的原因。" 这比当前的 "paradox" framing 更准确、更不容易被反驳。
- 价值: 命中 Novelty 维度。当前的 "paradox" framing 在逻辑上有漏洞（不同组件的不同预测不构成 paradox），修正后的 framing 更严谨——核心张力变成"缺乏 unified theory that accounts for both MLP and attention contributions across scale"，这更难被审稿人一句话 dismiss。
- 调研依据: 基于 Chen et al. (arXiv:2510.05554) 和 ASEntmax (ICLR 2026) 的理论范围（都只关注 attention/softmax），以及 Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032) 的 finding 明确在 MLP layers。两个理论体系描述不同组件，它们的预测不矛盾——它们只是不完整。

【状态】: 有缺陷待补救

【前置调研发现】
- **Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639)**: 使用 Llama-3-8B / Mistral-7B / Qwen2.5-7B 三模型，在 GSM8K 上 677 题做 activation patching + logit lens + CAI。每个模型约 60 个 flipped sample 做 full patching。核心发现是 failure localizability 高度 model-dependent（Llama 71.7% 可恢复，Qwen 0%）。实验未涉及长上下文。
- **DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175)**: 在 MRCR、LongBenchV2、RULER 等长上下文 benchmark 上评估，使用 retrieval heads (QRHeads) 做动态注意力缩放。基线包括 vanilla decoding、SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O 等 KV cache 压缩方法。评估模型包括 Llama-3.1-8B/70B、Qwen2.5-7B/32B。核心实验在 128K 上下文。
- **Du et al. (EMNLP Findings 2025, arXiv:2510.05381)**: 使用 0/3.75K/7.5K/15K/30K 五个 whitespace padding 条件，在 GSM8K/MMLU/HumanEval 上测试 5 个模型。实验包含 masked distractor 条件。是纯行为观测，无 circuit-level 分析。
- **Stream (arXiv:2510.19875)**: 提供 O(T log T) 近线性时间的 sparse attention 可视化，可在消费级 GPU 上处理 100K tokens，但仅用于注意力模式可视化，不直接做 activation patching。论文在 CoT traces 上验证可剪除 97-99% token interactions。
- **"How does Chain of Thought Think?" (arXiv:2507.22928)**: 在 Pythia-70M 和 Pythia-2.8B 上做 SAE + activation patching，验证 CoT 特征的因果贡献。使用 log-probability 作为因果影响的定量指标。方法论上是 SAE-based causal analysis 的直接先例，但仅在小模型（<3B）上操作。
- **Gemma Scope 2 (Google DeepMind 2025/2026)**: 提供 Gemma 3 全系列（270M-27B）每层的 SAE 和 transcoder，包括 instruction-tuned 版本。支持 Matryoshka training 和 cross-layer transcoder。已在 Neuronpedia 上开放。
- **Gemma 3 Technical Report (arXiv:2503.19786)**: Gemma 3 使用 **interleaved local-global attention**，每 5 个 local 层（span 仅 1024 tokens）搭配 1 个 global 层。这与 Llama 和 Qwen 的全 attention 架构根本不同。
- **Intelligence Degradation (arXiv:2601.15300)**: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上识别出 40-50% max context 处的 critical threshold，F1 从 0.55 骤降至 0.3。使用 natural length distribution 方法论。

- **调研总结**: 该领域当前的实验设计标准要求：(1) 至少 3 个架构差异显著的模型做跨模型比较；(2) AtP/RelP 等近似方法需要与 full patching 做 faithfulness validation；(3) 对 mechanistic claim 需要 both necessity（ablation 导致失败）和 sufficiency（patching 恢复成功）证据；(4) 审稿人普遍期望对不同 attention 架构（如 GQA、sliding window、full attention）的差异做明确讨论。

---

【缺陷 1】
- 类别: 实验设计不足（架构差异未处理）
- 问题: Proposal 将 Gemma-3-12B-it 与 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 并列进行统一的 causal tracing 方案，但 **Gemma 3 使用 interleaved local-global attention（每 5 个 local 层 span 仅 1024 tokens，搭配 1 个 global 层）**，而 Llama 和 Qwen 使用完整的 full attention。这意味着在 Gemma 3 上，padding tokens 超过 1024 距离后，5/6 的层根本无法 attend 到这些 tokens。这从根本上改变了 causal tracing 的解读：Gemma 3 上可能观察到的 "localized failure" 实际上可能是架构层面的 attention mask 限制，而非 reasoning circuit 的固有属性。Proposal 完全没有讨论这一架构差异对实验方法和结论的影响。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案: 
  (1) 在实验设计中明确区分 Gemma 3 的 local vs. global 层，分别报告 causal responsibility heatmap——local 层的 causal effect 在长 padding 条件下预期应该很弱（因为看不到 padding tokens），而 global 层应承载主要效应。这本身就是一个有意义的发现。
  (2) 在 H1/H2/H3 localizability 分析中，增加一个 sub-hypothesis：H3-Architecture 不仅意味着不同模型有不同 localizability，还意味着同一模型内 local vs. global 层有不同 failure mode。
  (3) 如果追求三模型可比性更重要，考虑替换 Gemma-3-12B 为另一个 full-attention 模型（如 Mistral-v0.3-7B，Du et al. 的原始测试模型之一），然后将 Gemma 3 作为附加的 architectural contrast 实验。
  (4) 至少在 paper 中明确讨论 sliding window 架构如何影响 padding tokens 的信息传播路径。
- 调研依据: Gemma 3 Technical Report (arXiv:2503.19786) 明确记载 interleaved local-global attention 架构；GitHub issue (google-deepmind/gemma#167) 确认 local 层 span 仅 1024 tokens。

【缺陷 2】
- 类别: 实验设计不足（padding 类型控制条件缺失）
- 问题: Proposal 继承了 Du et al. 的 whitespace padding 协议，但 **缺少 padding 类型的控制实验**。对于一个声称要做 "causal circuit dissection" 的工作，仅使用 whitespace padding 无法区分以下两种机制：(a) 纯粹的 positional shift / attention dilution 效应（任何类型的 padding 都会产生同样的 circuit disruption），(b) content-dependent 效应（whitespace 的 token embedding 本身影响 MLP/attention 行为）。这一区分对 H_unified vs. H_separate 的测试至关重要——如果不同 padding 类型产生不同的 disrupted circuit sets，这直接影响 overlap 分析的结论。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 增加至少一种替代 padding 条件：**random token padding**（从 vocabulary 中均匀采样 tokens）。在 2-3 个关键长度条件（如 1K、10K、25K）上运行，并与 whitespace padding 的 causal tracing heatmap 做对比。如果两者 disrupted component sets 高度重叠（Jaccard > 0.7），则确认效应是 position/attention-driven；如果差异显著，则需要在 mechanistic narrative 中区分 content-dependent pathway。
  (2) 这不需要对所有条件做完整的 tiered protocol，只需在 core conditions 上做抽检，计算量可控（约增加 20-30% GPU hours 在 Phase 3）。
  (3) Proposal 已有 position-controlled ablation（post-question padding），这是好的。但 padding type variation 是正交的另一个控制维度。
- 调研依据: Du et al. (arXiv:2510.05381) 使用了 whitespace 和 masked distractor 两种条件，发现效应模式不同，表明 padding 内容确实影响 degradation pattern。Proposal 的 causal tracing 应继承这一控制维度。

【缺陷 3】
- 类别: 可行性问题（micro-scale flipped sample 数量不足风险）
- 问题: Proposal 要求每个 model-condition pair 创建约 500 个 (short-context-correct, long-context-incorrect) paired examples。但在 **micro-scale 条件**（25/50/100 tokens padding）下，这些 7-8B 模型在 GSM8K 上的 accuracy 下降预计非常小（Shi et al. 显示这些长度甚至是 beneficial 的）。这意味着 flip rate 可能极低——正确答案变为错误答案的比例可能 <5%。从 GSM8K 的约 1300 条测试集中，可能只能找到 <65 个 flipped examples，远不足 500 个。在 "beneficial regime" 中做 causal tracing 的 sample 从何而来？
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 重新定义 micro-scale 的 causal tracing 目标：在 beneficial regime 中，tracing 的目标不应该是 flipped (correct→incorrect) samples，而是 **boosted (incorrect→correct) samples**——即在 zero-padding 时错误、但加入 25-50 tokens padding 后变为正确的例子。这些 sample 直接对应 Shi et al. 的 ARM 效应。
  (2) 同时收集 boosted samples 和 flipped samples。在 micro-scale 用 boosted samples 做 "beneficial circuit" 的 causal tracing，在 macro-scale 用 flipped samples 做 "harmful circuit" 的 causal tracing。然后比较两组 circuit 的 overlap → 直接测试 H_unified vs H_separate。
  (3) 使用 GSM-Infinite 的可调难度功能，生成难度适中的问题，确保 baseline accuracy 在 40-60% 范围，从而在 micro-scale 也能获得足够的 boosted samples。
  (4) 明确报告每个条件下实际获得的 paired sample 数量和 bootstrap power analysis。
- 调研依据: Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032) 报告短 padding 在 GSM8K 上提升 accuracy，意味着 micro-scale 的 "flip" 主要是 incorrect→correct 方向。Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639) 在 677 题中获得 28-45% flip rate 作为参考。

【缺陷 4】
- 类别: 评估方案缺陷（Jaccard overlap 阈值的中间地带）
- 问题: Proposal 使用 Jaccard overlap of top-50 component sets 来测试 H_unified (>0.5) vs. H_separate (<0.2)，但 **完全没有讨论 0.2-0.5 的中间结果意味着什么**。这个区间并不罕见——如果结果落在此处，论文的核心 hypothesis test 就无法得出清晰结论。审稿人一定会追问这个 gap。此外，top-50 的截断本身是 arbitrary 的，不同截断点可能改变 Jaccard 值。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 引入 **连续化指标** 替代或补充二元阈值：使用 weighted Jaccard（按 causal effect magnitude 加权），或计算两组 component 的 causal effect vector 的 cosine similarity。这些连续指标避免了 arbitrary threshold 的问题。
  (2) 做 **cutoff sensitivity analysis**：报告 top-20、top-50、top-100 components 的 Jaccard overlap，展示结论对 cutoff 选择的鲁棒性。
  (3) 明确定义中间区间的解读：0.2-0.5 可定义为 "partial overlap"，对应 "partially shared mechanism" 假说——某些 components 在两个 regime 中都活跃，但各 regime 还有自己特有的 components。这本身就是一个有意义的结论，应在实验设计中预先承认。
  (4) 补充 permutation test：随机 shuffle component labels，计算 null distribution 的 Jaccard overlap，确保观测到的 overlap 具有统计显著性。
- 调研依据: 基于领域实验规范判断——mechanistic interpretability 文献中 arbitrary thresholds 是常见审稿质疑点；Fragile Reasoning 的 localizability 测试也使用了连续化的 recovery rate 而非二元分类。

【缺陷 5】
- 类别: compute 公平性问题（Gemma-3-12B 与 7-8B 模型的参数量差异）
- 问题: Proposal 提到 "All H3 cross-model comparisons use normalized metrics (causally implicated components as % of total components) to control for Gemma-3-12B's larger parameter count"，这是好的。但 **Gemma-3-12B 有 ~48 layers（12B），而 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 有 ~32 layers**。百分比归一化无法完全控制的问题是：更深的模型本身可能有更多冗余层，使得 "关键 component 占比" 天然更低。此外，Gemma 3 的 interleaved local-global 架构使得每层的 "component" 定义本身就不可比——local 层的 attention head 功能受限于 1024 span，与 full-attention 层的 head 本质不同。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 在 normalized metrics 基础上，增加 **absolute metrics**（absolute number of causally implicated components 和 recovery rate）并行报告。
  (2) 对 Gemma-3-12B 单独报告 local-layer 和 global-layer 的归一化指标，不将两种层混在一起算百分比。
  (3) 考虑在 Llama 和 Qwen 之间做主要的 cross-model comparison（两者架构更可比），将 Gemma 3 作为 "architectural contrast" 而非等权对比。
  (4) 在写作中明确讨论参数量和架构差异对 cross-model comparison 的限制。
- 调研依据: Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639) 的跨模型比较仅用同规模模型（均为 7-8B），避免了此问题。DySCO 也在 7-8B tier 内做主要比较。

【缺陷 6】
- 类别: 可行性问题（full activation patching 在 25K-50K tokens 的计算量可能被低估）
- 问题: Proposal 估计 targeted activation patching on top-50 components 需要 ~220 H100 hours。但让我们粗略计算：3 models × ~12 conditions × ~500 examples × 50 components × 2 forward passes (clean + patched) = 1,800,000 forward passes。在 25K tokens 时，一个 8B 模型的单次 forward pass 约 3-5 秒（H100, bfloat16），则总计约 1,500-2,500 GPU hours——**远超 220 小时的估计**。即使只在 core conditions（1K/5K/10K/25K）上做 full patching（4 conditions），也约 360K forward passes = ~300-500 hours。估计值可能低估了 5-10 倍。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) **大幅缩减 full patching 的覆盖范围**：不对所有 12 个 padding conditions 都做 top-50 full patching。建议选择 3-4 个关键 conditions（如 0, 50, 5K, 25K——覆盖 micro-beneficial、transition、macro-harmful 三个 regime）做 full patching，其余 conditions 仅用 AtP/RelP screening 结果。
  (2) **减少每个 condition 的 sample 数**：从 500 减至 200 per condition for full patching（AtP screening 可保持 500）。200 examples 配合 bootstrap 仍可产生合理的 confidence intervals。
  (3) **batch processing 优化**：利用 KV cache 共享——同一 clean input 的 KV cache 可在 50 个 component patching 实验中复用，减少重复 prefill 开销。
  (4) 重新估算 GPU budget：建议将 full patching 预算调整为 400-600 H100 hours（占总预算的主要部分），总预算调至 600-900 H100 hours（$1,500-$2,250）。
- 调研依据: 基于领域实验规范判断——Fragile Reasoning 仅对 60 个 flipped samples 做 full patching（而非 500），"How does CoT Think?" 使用小模型（<3B）做 SAE patching 以控制计算成本。大规模 full patching 在 8-12B 模型 + 25K+ tokens 上的计算开销是公开可查的工程约束。

【缺陷 7】
- 类别: 评估方案缺陷（MMLU 的异质性问题）
- 问题: Proposal 将 MMLU 作为 "knowledge-intensive generalization check"，但 MMLU 包含 57 个 subjects，从 abstract algebra 到 professional medicine，任务类型高度异质。对 MMLU 做 causal tracing 时，不同 subject 的 circuit 可能完全不同，aggregate 的 causal responsibility heatmap 会很 noisy。此外，MMLU 是 multiple-choice format（4 选 1），而 GSM8K/MATH 是 free-form numerical answers——两种 format 的 "correct→incorrect flip" 定义和 patching 目标（patching 哪个 logit？）有本质区别。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 如果 MMLU 的目的仅是 "generalization check"（验证 length-induced degradation 在知识密集型任务上也存在），则只需报告 **behavioral results**（accuracy vs. padding length curves），不需要对 MMLU 做 full causal tracing。这大幅节省计算资源。
  (2) 如果确实要对非推理任务做 causal tracing，选择 MMLU 的一个同质子集（如 STEM subjects 或 professional medicine），而非全部 57 subjects。
  (3) 明确 MMLU 的 patching 目标：multiple-choice 格式下，patching target 应该是 correct choice token 的 logit（如 "A"/"B"/"C"/"D"），与 GSM8K 的 final numerical answer logit 不同。这需要在方法论中显式说明。
- 调研依据: Du et al. (arXiv:2510.05381) 在 MMLU 上仅报告了 aggregate accuracy degradation，未做 component-level analysis。Fragile Reasoning 仅在 GSM8K 上做 causal tracing，避免了 task heterogeneity 问题。

【缺陷 8】
- 类别: ablation 不完整（probing protocol 缺乏 token position 规范）
- 问题: Phase 5 的 probing protocol 描述为 "Train linear probes on residual-stream representations at every layer"，但 **未指定 probe 在哪个 token position 的 representation 上操作**。对于有 padding 的输入（可能 25K tokens），residual stream 在不同 token positions 有不同的 representation。是 probe 最后一个 token 的 representation？question 最后一个 token？answer 区域？这个选择直接影响 "information preservation vs. propagation failure" 的诊断结果。
- 严重度: 可补救
- 补救方案:
  (1) 明确规定 probe 操作在 **最后一个 question token 的 residual stream representation** 上（即 padding 后、generation 前的最后一个 token position）。这是最自然的选择，因为模型需要从此处开始 generation。
  (2) 作为 ablation，额外 probe padding 前的最后一个 question token position（即 position L，如 proposal 中 position-controlled ablation 所定义），比较两者的 probe accuracy 差异以量化 positional shift 的影响。
  (3) 这是一个小的写作/规范问题，不影响核心实验设计，但审稿人可能追问。
- 调研依据: "Transformers Know but Don't Tell" (arXiv:2406.14673) 在特定 token position 上做 probing，明确指定了 probe 的 position 选择策略。

---

**总结**: 该 proposal 的实验框架总体设计良好——tiered padding protocol、validation pilot、multi-method causal tracing (AtP → full patching → path patching)、跨模型比较、position-controlled ablation、statistical rigor 等方面都体现了成熟的实验设计思路。上述缺陷中，**缺陷 1（Gemma 3 sliding window 架构）和缺陷 6（compute 估算偏低）是最关键的**，前者可能导致跨模型比较的结论被审稿人质疑，后者可能导致项目执行中遇到资源瓶颈。其余缺陷均为可通过增加控制条件或细化 protocol 来补救的中等问题。没有发现不可补救的方向性致命缺陷——实验方案的核心逻辑（causal tracing across scale transition）是 sound 的。

## Architecture Overview

The updated model architecture is composed of repeating interleaving blocks, each containing 5 local attention layers with a sliding window of 1024 and 1 global attention layer.

## Local Attention Layers

Local attention layers operate with a constrained sliding window of only 1024 tokens. Each token in a local layer can only "see" a small, fixed window of recent tokens (specifically, the last 1024 tokens), which is sufficient for most language understanding tasks, which rely heavily on immediate context.

## Interleaving Pattern

The architecture employs a repeating pattern of 5 local layers followed by 1 global layer. Global layers attend to the entire context.

## Memory Efficiency Benefits

This hybrid method slashes attention computations by ~5× and trims KV cache memory from ~60% to just ~15%—freeing up VRAM for bigger contexts and faster inference. Memory savings are achieved without degrading perplexity.

## Purpose

This design enables the model to capture both short- and long-range dependencies, leading to more accurate and contextually relevant responses.

I found the research paper you were looking for! Here's a summary of the key findings:

The paper studies the puzzling observation that inserting long sequences of meaningless tokens before the query prompt can consistently enhance LLM reasoning performance. The research specifically examined repeated punctuation or separators as examples of meaningless tokens.

The improvements arise from a redistribution of activations in the LLM's MLP layers, where near zero activations become less frequent while large magnitude activations increase, which enhances the model's representational capacity by suppressing weak signals and promoting stronger, more informative ones.

Based on these insights, the authors proposed the Activation Redistribution Module (ARM), a lightweight inference-time technique that modifies activations directly without altering the input sequence and adaptively identifies near-zero activations after the non-linear function and shifts them outward.

Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and model architectures show that ARM consistently improves LLM performance on reasoning tasks while requiring only a few lines of simple code to implement.

The paper was authored by Zeru Shi and colleagues and published in October 2025 (arXiv:2510.01032).

Based on the search results, I found the paper you're looking for:

"Localized Definitions and Distributed Reasoning: A Proof-of-Concept Mechanistic Interpretability Study via Activation Patching" investigates the localization of knowledge representation in fine-tuned GPT-2 models using Causal Layer Attribution via Activation Patching (CLAP), a method that identifies critical neural layers responsible for correct answer generation.

The model was fine-tuned on 9,958 PubMed abstracts (epilepsy: 20,595 mentions, EEG: 11,674 mentions, seizure: 13,921 mentions) using two configurations with validation loss monitoring for early stopping.

CLAP involved (1) caching clean (correct answer) and corrupted (incorrect answer) activations, (2) computing logit difference to quantify model preference, and (3) patching corrupted activations with clean ones to assess recovery.

Results revealed three findings: First, patching the first feedforward layer recovered 56% of correct preference, demonstrating that associative knowledge is distributed across multiple layers.

The paper (arXiv 2504.02976) was submitted on April 3, 2025, and is authored by Nooshin Bahador. It's a 15-page paper with 3 figures focused on machine learning and artificial intelligence.

# Causal Circuit Dissection of Scale-Dependent Reasoning Degradation in Transformers: From Beneficial Activation Redistribution to Catastrophic Length Failure

## Description
Three concurrent empirical findings establish a striking puzzle: short meaningless token sequences (~10-50 repeated punctuation tokens) improve reasoning via first-layer MLP activation redistribution following an inverted-U curve (Shi et al., arXiv:2510.01032), yet long whitespace padding (3.75K-30K tokens) degrades reasoning 13.9-85% even with perfect retrieval (Du et al., EMNLP Findings 2025, arXiv:2510.05381), with hidden representation shifts detectable even at small scales (Himelstein et al., NeurIPS 2025 Workshop, arXiv:2510.01238). Current theoretical frameworks for length-induced degradation — Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical scaling (arXiv:2510.05554) and ASEntmax's unbounded softmax entropy proof (ICLR 2026) — operate solely on the attention mechanism and predict monotonic degradation, but are silent on MLP-mediated effects. No existing theory addresses the cross-component interaction between attention-mediated degradation and MLP-mediated redistribution across scale. Critically, Shi et al. used repeated punctuation tokens while Du et al. used whitespace — whether these distinct token types produce a single continuous non-monotonic curve or two independent phenomena is itself an open empirical question that this work resolves as a first step.

We perform the first causal, component-level dissection of this phenomenon. We test three hypothesis dimensions: **(1) Localizability:** H1-Localized (degradation concentrated in <5% of components with >50% recovery) vs. H2-Distributed (no small subset sufficient) vs. H3-Architecture-dependent (model-specific, following the Fragile Reasoning paper's finding that Llama-3 failures are localizable while Qwen2.5 failures are distributed, arXiv:2604.01639). **(2) Circuit overlap:** H_unified (micro-beneficial and macro-harmful effects mediated by the same components in different regimes) vs. H_separate (mediated by distinct component sets). Shi et al.'s benefit localizes to first-layer MLP activation redistribution; DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175) achieves 25% improvement on 128K-context reasoning by upweighting retrieval heads — suggesting benefit (MLP-mediated) and failure mitigation (attention head-mediated) may involve different circuitry. **(3) Cross-component dependency:** H_interaction (MLP benefit depends on attention functionality — at macro-scale, attention degradation renders MLP redistribution unusable even if it still occurs) vs. H_independent (MLP and attention effects are additive with no dependency).

Using a tiered padding protocol across Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (128K native, full attention), Gemma-3-12B-it (128K native, interleaved local-global attention per Gemma 3 Technical Report arXiv:2503.19786), and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (32K native, full attention), we apply a two-stage causal tracing strategy: Attribution Patching (AtP-IG / RelP) as efficient first-pass screen, validated against full patching at long contexts via a dedicated pilot, followed by targeted full activation patching on top-50 candidates at 4 key scale conditions (micro-beneficial, transition, macro-harmful, extreme). Benchmarks include GSM8K, GSM-Infinite (ICML 2025, arXiv:2502.05252) at calibrated difficulty for sufficient flip/boost rates, MATH, and MMLU (behavioral verification only). Phase 1 explicitly tests both whitespace and repeated punctuation padding at micro-scale to verify whether the non-monotonic curve holds within a single token type. A position-controlled ablation (post-question padding) isolates positional encoding confounds. At micro-scale, causal tracing uses boosted (incorrect→correct) samples to identify "beneficial circuits"; at macro-scale, flipped (correct→incorrect) samples identify "harmful circuits"; the overlap between these two circuit sets directly tests H_unified vs H_separate using continuous metrics (weighted Jaccard, cosine similarity, cutoff sensitivity analysis, permutation tests). Gemma-3-12B serves dual purpose: Gemma Scope 2 SAE/transcoder feature-level decomposition, and architectural contrast (its 5-local-1-global interleaved attention, with local layers spanning only 1024 tokens, produces fundamentally different padding-interaction patterns than full-attention models). Cross-referencing maps disrupted components against SurfaceLogicKV's logic-construction heads (arXiv:2508.15806), Wu et al.'s retrieval heads (arXiv:2404.15574), DySCO's heuristic intervention targets (arXiv:2602.22175), and per-head attention entropy relative to Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical scaling.

The key deliverable is a mechanistic answer to whether the beneficial-to-harmful transition reflects a single circuit overloading, competing circuits, or a cross-component dependency — directly informing whether length-robust interventions should target a unified mechanism, address distinct failure modes, or restore inter-component dependencies. Beyond explaining accuracy degradation, the component-level findings may illuminate why models compress reasoning traces and reduce self-verification under length pressure (Rodionov et al., arXiv:2604.01161). Each hypothesis outcome yields distinct engineering implications: principled component selection for inference-time intervention (improving on DySCO's heuristic retrieval-head selection), targeted regularization for long-context fine-tuning, or model-selection guidance based on architectural failure signatures.

## Core Problem
Why does padding-induced input length modulate transformer reasoning — improving performance at micro-scale (~10-50 tokens) via MLP activation redistribution, yet degrading it 13.9-85% at macro-scale (~10K-30K tokens) — and are these effects mediated by the same components operating in different regimes (with or without cross-component dependency), or by distinct component sets? A prerequisite question: do these two effects (observed with different padding types) form a continuous scale-dependent phenomenon, or are they independent token-type-specific mechanisms?

## Opportunity
Three concurrent empirical findings create a puzzle with no mechanistic resolution. Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032) showed short meaningless tokens (~10-50 repeated punctuation) *improve* reasoning via first-layer MLP activation redistribution (ARM effect), following an inverted-U curve collapsing beyond ~50-70 tokens. Du et al. (EMNLP Findings 2025, arXiv:2510.05381) demonstrated long whitespace padding (3.75K-30K tokens) degrades reasoning 13.9-85% across 5 LLMs even with perfect retrieval and masked distractors, explicitly calling for "further exploration of underlying mechanisms." Himelstein et al. (NeurIPS 2025 Workshop, arXiv:2510.01238) showed even small padding shifts hidden representations, degrades quality, and weakens safety guardrails. A critical but overlooked detail: Shi et al. used repeated punctuation tokens while Du et al. used whitespace — whether these produce a single continuous phenomenon or two independent effects is an open question that must be resolved before any unified mechanistic account is possible.

Current theoretical frameworks predict only monotonic attention degradation: Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical scaling (arXiv:2510.05554) and ASEntmax's unbounded softmax entropy proof (ICLR 2026). These are entirely attention-centric and silent on MLP behavior. The MLP-mediated micro-scale benefit (Shi et al.) lies outside their explanatory scope, meaning these theories — even if correct for the attention component — cannot explain the full multi-component phenomenon. No existing theory addresses how attention-mediated degradation and MLP-mediated redistribution interact across scale; predicting where their combined effect transitions requires component-level causal evidence that no theoretical framework provides. The Intrinsic Entropy paper (arXiv:2502.01481) links training data to optimal context length but provides no component-level evidence.

Activation patching tools are now mature: Anthropic's 2025 circuit tracing at production scale (Attribution Graphs); Syed et al.'s AtP (NeurIPS 2023 Workshop, arXiv:2310.10348); RelP with LRP propagation (NeurIPS 2025 MechInterp Workshop Spotlight, arXiv:2508.21258); Stream (arXiv:2510.19875) enabling mechanistic interpretability at 100K-token contexts. DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175, Feb 2026) demonstrates that heuristic retrieval-head upweighting yields up to 25% improvement on 128K-context reasoning — proving head-level intervention works without explaining why. Notably, DySCO's substantial recovery from purely attention-based intervention suggests either (a) MLP components are not independently damaged at macro-scale, or (b) MLP damage exists but is less impactful than attention damage — both testable predictions. "How does Chain of Thought Think?" (arXiv:2507.22928) establishes SAE + activation patching as viable for feature-level causal analysis of reasoning.

The Fragile Reasoning paper (arXiv:2604.01639) revealed Llama-3 failures under surface perturbations are localizable (71.7% recoverable) while Qwen2.5 failures are distributed (0%). This raises the question of whether length-induced degradation follows the same pattern — but length perturbation differs qualitatively from surface perturbation: it does not alter semantic signal content but changes computational path length, attention distribution, and positional encoding regime, potentially producing fundamentally different localizability patterns. "Localized Definitions and Distributed Reasoning" (arXiv:2504.02976) found factual knowledge localized and associative reasoning distributed in GPT-2 using CLAP, but on a different perturbation dimension (task type, not length) and model scale.

## Landscape
**Empirical phenomenon (well-established):** Du et al. (EMNLP Findings 2025) showed 13.9-85% degradation across Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-v0.3-7B, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5, and Gemini-2.0 using whitespace padding at 0/3.75K/7.5K/15K/30K tokens on GSM8K, MMLU, and HumanEval. The Intelligence Degradation paper (arXiv:2601.15300) identified critical thresholds at 40-50% of max context. Rodionov et al. (arXiv:2604.01161) showed longer context compresses reasoning traces by up to 50% with reduced self-verification — behavioral observation suggesting not just accuracy loss but qualitative reasoning behavior change, without component-level tracing. The Chroma Context Rot Report (2025) confirmed context rot as intrinsic to attention architectures across 18 models.

**Paradoxical micro-scale benefit:** Shi et al. (arXiv:2510.01032) demonstrated short meaningless tokens (~10-50 repeated punctuation) *improve* reasoning by redistributing MLP activations in the first layer (ARM effect), following an inverted-U curve peaking around 50 tokens. Himelstein et al. (arXiv:2510.01238, NeurIPS 2025 Workshop) showed even small padding shifts hidden representations across Llama, Gemma, and Qwen families.

**Theoretical accounts (attention-only, monotonic):** Chen et al. (arXiv:2510.05554) proved attention phase transition at β_n = log(n). ASEntmax (ICLR 2026) proved unbounded softmax entropy growth. Both predict monotonic attention degradation; neither addresses MLP-mediated effects or cross-component interactions.

**Inference-time intervention (heuristic):** DySCO (arXiv:2602.22175) leverages Wu et al.'s retrieval heads for dynamic attention rescaling, achieving 25% relative improvement at 128K context. Proves head-level intervention works but provides no mechanistic explanation for component selection or coverage completeness.

**Mechanistic interpretability on related problems:** Wu et al. (arXiv:2404.15574) identified retrieval heads (<5%, critical for CoT reasoning). SurfaceLogicKV (arXiv:2508.15806) classified heads: 98.5% irrelevant-info-ignoring, 1.5% logic-construction, 0.5% surface memorization. "Transformers Know but Don't Tell" (EMNLP Findings 2024, arXiv:2406.14673) showed models internally represent answers they fail to output. Fragile Reasoning (arXiv:2604.01639): Llama-3 failures localized (71.7%), Qwen distributed (0%). CircuitProbe (Panuganti, arXiv:2604.00716) identified reasoning circuits via layer duplication. Fartale et al. (arXiv:2510.03366) disentangled recall vs. reasoning circuits. "Localized Definitions and Distributed Reasoning" (arXiv:2504.02976) found factual knowledge localized, associative reasoning distributed in GPT-2. "How does Chain of Thought Think?" (arXiv:2507.22928) used SAE + activation patching for feature-level CoT causal analysis, finding CoT induces sparser, more causally effective features in larger models.

**Critical gap:** No existing work uses causal interventions to trace where pure length disrupts reasoning circuits. Specifically: (1) no work verifies whether micro-scale benefit (Shi et al., punctuation tokens) and macro-scale harm (Du et al., whitespace) form a continuous phenomenon; (2) no work identifies which components mediate the transition; (3) no work tests cross-component dependency (whether MLP benefit requires attention functionality); (4) DySCO demonstrates intervention works but lacks mechanistic grounding.

## Approach
**Phase 1 — Reproduction, padding-type verification, and scale-transition characterization (Weeks 1-3).** Reproduce Du et al.'s padding protocol across Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (128K native, full attention), Gemma-3-12B-it (128K native, interleaved 5-local-1-global attention with 1024-token local span per arXiv:2503.19786), and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (32K native, full attention, capped within native window). **Benchmarks:** GSM8K and GSM-Infinite (ICML 2025, arXiv:2502.05252) at calibrated difficulty (target 40-60% baseline accuracy to ensure sufficient boosted/flipped samples); MATH for harder reasoning; MMLU for behavioral verification only (accuracy vs. padding length curves, no causal tracing). **Padding-type verification (critical):** At micro-scale (0/25/50/100/200/500/750 tokens), test both whitespace padding AND repeated punctuation tokens (replicating Shi et al.'s protocol). If whitespace produces no micro-scale benefit, the two phenomena are token-type-specific; if both produce the inverted-U curve, a unified scale-dependent account is supported. At core scale (1K/5K/10K/25K tokens), test whitespace (primary) plus random vocabulary tokens at 1K/10K/25K as robustness check. Extended: 50K tokens, whitespace only, Llama and Gemma only. All cross-model comparisons normalized by token count with tokenizer encoding differences reported. **Paired datasets:** At micro-scale, collect both boosted (incorrect→correct, for beneficial circuit tracing) and flipped (correct→incorrect) samples. At macro-scale, collect flipped samples (~200-500 per condition). At micro-scale, measure first-layer MLP activation distributions (replicating ARM finding) and per-head attention entropy. **Also measure MLP activation patterns at macro-scale** to test H_interaction: does ARM-pattern redistribution still occur at 10K-25K tokens, or does the MLP response itself change? **Position-controlled ablation:** For core conditions, run parallel set with padding after the question (preserving question at position [0, L]) to isolate positional encoding confounds (supported by position bias literature, arXiv:2502.01951).

**Phase 2 — Validation pilot and efficient causal screening (Weeks 3-6).** **Validation pilot (Week 3):** On Llama + Qwen (full-attention models) × 3 length conditions (1K, 10K, 25K) × 50-100 examples, simultaneously run AtP-IG (Syed et al., arXiv:2310.10348), RelP (arXiv:2508.21258), and full activation patching on all ~1024 components. Compute Spearman ρ to verify approximate methods at long contexts despite LayerNorm nonlinearities. If ρ < 0.7, fall back to full patching with gradient checkpointing + bfloat16. **Main screening (Weeks 4-6):** Apply validated method across all model-condition pairs. For Gemma-3-12B, run AtP separately on local vs. global layers to isolate sliding-window effects. Use Stream (arXiv:2510.19875) for attention pattern visualization only.

**Phase 3 — Targeted full activation patching and path patching (Weeks 6-9).** Apply full activation patching to top-50 components at **4 key scale conditions per model**: micro-beneficial (~50 tokens), transition (~750 tokens), macro-harmful (~10K tokens), extreme (~25K tokens). Sample size: 200 examples per condition (sufficient for bootstrap 95% CIs). Swap short-context activation into long-context pass, measure accuracy recovery. At micro-scale, patch beneficial circuits using boosted samples (swap long-context activation into short-context incorrect pass). Apply path patching to top-20 components for information-flow edge tracing. Compute CAI (Cascading Amplification Index, from Fragile Reasoning, arXiv:2604.01639). **H_unified vs H_separate test:** Compare component sets from micro-beneficial tracing (boosted samples) and macro-harmful tracing (flipped samples) using weighted Jaccard (by causal effect magnitude), cosine similarity of full causal effect vectors, and cutoff sensitivity analysis (top-20/50/100). Report permutation-test null distribution for statistical significance. Partial overlap (0.2-0.5) interpreted as "partially shared mechanism" — some shared components plus regime-specific ones. For Gemma-3-12B, separately report local-layer vs global-layer causal responsibility.

**Phase 4 — Cross-referencing, DySCO comparison, and mechanistic synthesis (Weeks 9-11).** Cross-reference disrupted components with: (a) SurfaceLogicKV head classification (arXiv:2508.15806); (b) Wu et al.'s retrieval heads (arXiv:2404.15574); (c) DySCO's intervention targets (arXiv:2602.22175) — overlap analysis between causally-implicated heads and DySCO's retrieval-head selection; test whether causal heatmap identifies non-retrieval components DySCO misses; (d) per-head attention entropy vs. Chen et al.'s β_n = log(n) critical threshold (arXiv:2510.05554). For Gemma-3-12B, leverage Gemma Scope 2 SAEs and transcoders (Google DeepMind, 2026) for feature-level decomposition, tracking feature activation/deactivation across the scale transition. All H3 cross-model comparisons: Llama vs Qwen as primary (both full attention, comparable ~7-8B scale); Gemma as architectural contrast with separate local/global reporting. Normalized metrics (% of total components) alongside absolute counts.

**Phase 5 — Probing, hypothesis testing, and statistical validation (Weeks 11-13).** **Probing protocol:** Linear probes at every layer on the residual stream representation at the **last question token position** (the position from which generation begins). Training data: short-context correct examples' representations. Probe target: final-answer correctness. Layer-by-layer accuracy under long-context conditions distinguishes: information preservation (high early/middle accuracy) + propagation failure (sharp drop at specific layers, consistent with H1) vs. global corruption (uniform decline, consistent with H2). Extends "Transformers Know but Don't Tell" (arXiv:2406.14673) from retrieval to reasoning under length pressure. Test all three hypothesis dimensions: localizability (H1/H2/H3), circuit overlap (H_unified/H_separate), cross-component dependency (H_interaction/H_independent). **Statistical rigor:** All rates with bootstrap 95% CIs; cross-model comparisons via permutation tests; AtP rankings via split-half stability (Spearman ρ on random 50/50 example splits).

**Phase 6 — Scale-transition mechanistic narrative (Weeks 13-15).** Synthesize into mechanistic account: trace how first-layer MLP activation redistribution (ARM effect) interacts with attention entropy growth, retrieval head disruption, and logic-construction head failure across scale. Key question: does MLP redistribution still occur at macro-scale (H_interaction test), and if so, why can't downstream components utilize it? Connect findings to Rodionov et al.'s (arXiv:2604.01161) observation that long context compresses reasoning and reduces self-verification — do the disrupted components correspond to verification-related circuits? Deliverable: component-level circuit diagram of the scale transition, with implications for principled intervention design (improving on DySCO's heuristic), long-context training regularization, and architecture selection.
